g.text: 1. Ask - one live agent, run by the skill

text.tspan: Logbook - for you, no ant reads it
the bridge to the next run
gets each answer as a message
one per task with a bug, in parallel:
finds why a bug is still open
after a failed fix, writes the
its inspector at once (task or fix)
